EVs total proteins were digested with trypsin (Promega, V5111), while glycoproteins were digested with trypsin and PNGase F (New England Biolabs, P0704) overnight at 37°C using the Filter aided sample preparation (FASP) approach as previously described (Wang et al.).
Briefly, 300 µg of protein was digested by trypsin and aliquoted.

enrichment_method.evidence: N‐glycoproteins of 95C EVs and 95D EVs were extracted by lectin Concanavalin A (ConA) affinity chromatography according to the protocol of the manufacturer.
Intact glycopeptides were enriched via a ZIC‐HILIC (Merck) based solid‐phase extraction (SPE) method.

enrichment_method.evidence: Phosphorylated peptides were enriched by titanium (IV) ion immobilized metal ion affinity chromatography (Ti4+‐IMAC) material according to the protocol of the manufacturer.

instrument.evidence: The EV total protein peptides and peptides with removed glycans after enrichment were analyzed using the Easy‐nanoLC1000 (250 mm × 50 µm column packed with 3 µm C18‐AQ particles) coupled with an Orbitrap Q‐Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

The intact glycopeptides were analyzed using the Vanquish nanoscale liquid chromatography system (200 mm × 75 µm column packed with 3 µm C18‐AQ particles) coupled with an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
